States that the existing Security Rule (with required vs addressable implementation specifications) remains the operative law to comply with today

Gives the right advice: build against the current Security Rule now, track the proposal, and do not treat NPRM provisions as current legal requirements — while noting MFA/encryption are best practice regardless
